title: Blucon can not pair at a standalone smartwatch and an android tablet
body:
Dear All,

Since now i have used the blucon at my lg mobilephone without any problem. I have bought an android tablet and a standalone android smartwatch but blucon does not pair either with the tablet neither with the smartwatch. I do not try to connect all the devices at the same time. For example at the smartwatch other the other devices was inactive...and when i am trying to connect from bluetooth option of the smartwatch it is says wrond password key....any thoughts??? from xdrip status i insert the pin but it is not bonded at all....any thoughts??? 
![26197841_1679973895382716_3072841371593373285_o](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/21019084/34496070-cc7ddcae-f000-11e7-9d9b-8121ae2a89d6.jpg)

comments.body: did you delete pairing from your LG phone?

Manage to unpair blucon with my lg....when i am inserting blucon 6.digits at xdrip message status down.at center xdrip pairing....at system status blucon is not connected when i tap to bond this probably work at hm10 device.it would take 1 minute. I am trying to connect directly blucon at a standalone cellurar smartwatch any thoughts?

the model of the smartwatch is here https://www.lightinthebox.com/hhyn8-smart-watch-wireless-charging-android-5-1-system-wifi-gps-2g-3g-call-500w-hd-camera-can-download-and-install-applications-independently_p6021947.html ... please help me is for my 8 yeas old son!

Are you sure you have deleted pairing from your LG phone? you need to make sure Blucon is not connected to another devices. Go BT settings and remove Blucon device.

best is you delete pairing from all 3 devices.

then you need to pair from within xdrip, not from BT settings.

My dear Gregory i have all the other device  competely inactive..i have remove the battery from blucon for 30 seconds and try to pair directly from xdrip....the worlds bonded and paired are the same one? I am asking you this because when  i insert the 6 digits from xdirp via bluetooth scan a message at the center of xdrip shows and it says pairing....and when i am scanning the only device that founds my smartwatch is the blucon !!!!

yes: now we need logs. would you be able to send logcat? if yes, we need all logs containing Dex and GATT during scan and pairing.

I think this kind of watch has BT issue.

thanks

My dear Gregory, i have sent you to day the logcat please confirm that you have received it. I have done all of these you have mentioned, unpair blucon from my lg etc... I have examine the smartwatch bluetooth and i have paired it with 3 different mobile. Hope to be able to paired it with newer versions of xdrip. If we achieved that we open for all diabetic people a new world of treatment.
